SpiceJet plane tire bursts during landing in Darbhanga, passengers safe

A SpiceJet flight from Mumbai to Darbhanga experienced a tire burst while landing at Darbhanga airport. The pilot's actions prevented a major accident, and all approximately 150 passengers on board were safely evacuated. One report mentioned an Akasa flight being cancelled, and another noted an IndiGo flight being diverted.
